name: Grilled chicken
summary: Grilled chicken named with the bamboo-tube rice, and again on a Tô Hiến Thành chicken menu.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng names gà nướng toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan, and at Lẩu Gà Số 7.
howToEat: With cơm lam, the food-tour note puts it beside forest meat and grilled eggs. At Số 7 it is one of the chicken plates, with boiled chicken, chicken steamed with fish sauce, and a hotpot. A marinade was not printed.
where: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village. Lẩu Gà Số 7, 7 Tô Hiến Thành, open 10:00–22:00.
priceBand: A price for the grilled chicken alone is Check on arrival. Số 7 prints 50,000–200,000 VND for the door, not per plate. The village plate has no price.
